title: Specified signed Roos and open projection completion interface
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$, and the already specified ordinary ringed open operations $o$, coefficient calculi $S_X,S_U$, ordinary reductions $A_X,A_U$, finite tensor comparisons $st$, semilinear tensor comparison $m$, integral reduction comparison $c$, and strict quotient comparison $q$. The completed coefficient module categories, flat-term K-flat complexes, ordinary and completed tensor functors, their representative comparisons and the actual quotient unit maps are those of [lem-sf-open-tensor-quotient-augmentation]. All complexes are unbounded and natural-number index $n$ means positive quotient exponent $n+1$. Define the boundary of a strict tower $T$ to be $1-s$ on $P_T=\prod_nT_n$, where the $n$th projection of $s$ is the $(n+1)$st projection followed by its transition. Define $F$ on towers termwise. A normalized Roos comparison for an additive functor $F$ consists of product isomorphisms with hom $F(P_T)\to P_{FT}$ fixed by every projection; a natural chain isomorphism $\operatorname{Roos}(T)F\cong\operatorname{Roos}(FT)$ whose first and shifted coordinates are $F$ of the original coordinates followed by the product isomorphism; and preservation of every strict augmentation with coordinates $(\operatorname{lift}(a_n),0)$ as an equality of actual chain maps. Its derived comparison is the exact-functor localization comparison followed by localization of this chain isomorphism.
Let $i$ include the constructible pairs into $D(B_U)\times D(B_X)$, $L=(j_!\times1)$, $R=(1\times j^*)$, $H=iL\widehat\otimes_X$, $I=iR\widehat\otimes_U$, and $H'=Ij_!$. CompletionData is the proposition that simultaneously there exist normalized extension and restriction Roos comparisons, module and derived unit isomorphisms equal to the actual open adjunction units, conversion from good to flat-term K-flat representatives, preservation of good representatives under extension and restriction, an ordinary tensor projection isomorphism with its chain-representative equation, and $\Gamma:H\cong H'$ satisfying $\chi_X\Gamma=\gamma^B j_!(\chi_U)$. Both chi maps are invertible on each constructible pair. For every normalized strict square its representative equation is $\Gamma\,j_!(t_U)\lambda=j_!$-input comparison followed by $t_X\operatorname{Roos}(\gamma_\bullet)$, where $t_W$ is the specified completed-tensor representative comparison. Finally there is a tensor/restriction isomorphism $Hj^*\cong I$ equal to $j^*\Gamma$ followed by the inverse derived unit; on every good pair it is computed by the restriction Roos comparison and the tower map $\delta=j^*(\gamma_\bullet)u^{-1}$, with each degree and level fixed by that formula. Completion existentially supplies finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation of restriction together with CompletionData. These are predicates on the recorded functors, not choices of replacement functors or existence assertions. The propositions OrdinaryRepresentative, CompletedRepresentative and RestrictionRepresentative name the three displayed representative clauses verbatim. CompletionData uses these proposition names; expanding them restores the original formula exactly.
